meta.name: add-macos-statusbar
meta.description: Add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. Shows a bolt icon with a green/red dot indicating whether NanoClaw is running, with Start, Stop, and Restart controls. macOS only.

copy.tagline: 在菜单栏显示 NanoClaw 运行状态并控制启停
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 macOS 菜单栏快速查看和切换 NanoClaw 运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Show NanoClaw status and controls in macOS menu bar
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly check and toggle NanoClaw from the macOS menu bar

howto.what: 安装后,Mac 菜单栏会出现一个带绿点或红点的闪电图标:绿点表示 NanoClaw 正在运行,红点表示已停止。点开图标可看到运行状态,以及启动、停止、重启和查看日志等控制。
howto.when: 当你在 Mac 上要求为 NanoClaw 添加菜单栏状态指示器时触发。技能会检查系统、编译安装,并在菜单栏加载图标。

say.text: 我想给 NanoClaw 加一个 macOS 菜单栏状态图标
say.note: Claude 会检查你的 Mac 环境并帮你安装

say.text: 帮我装一个能启停 NanoClaw 的菜单栏指示器
say.note: 装好后菜单栏会出现闪电图标,点击可控制服务

say.text: 让 NanoClaw 在 Mac 菜单栏显示运行状态和重启按钮
say.note: Claude 会完成编译并加载后台服务

howto.what_en: After installation, a lightning-bolt icon appears in the macOS menu bar, with a green dot when NanoClaw is running and a red dot when it is stopped. Clicking it shows the status and offers Start, Stop, Restart, and log-view controls.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add a macOS menu-bar status indicator for NanoClaw. The skill checks the platform and tools, compiles the helper, and loads it via launchd.

say_en.text: Add a macOS menu bar status icon for NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Claude checks your Mac and installs it.

say_en.text: Help me add a NanoClaw menu bar indicator with start and stop controls.
say_en.note: A bolt icon appears; click it to control the service.

say_en.text: Show NanoClaw's run state and a restart button in the Mac menu bar.
say_en.note: Claude compiles and loads the background service.
